title: Encoded first-match UInt64 equality search
summary: Executes the compiler's forward one-word equality search and exposes its none or first-match result through the emitted zero-or-index-plus-one encoding.
premises: A checked leanexe.array.find-idx-eq.v1 equality with program scratch key
The compiler layout with combined input local 0, item local 1, scratch at least 2, and an arbitrary trailing-local count
A flat one-word Array UInt64 at the input pointer
The literal predicate element == key, a scan starting at zero, the zero-or-index-plus-one result encoding, and fallthrough
Continuation proofs for the none case and every possible first-match index
result: The exact emitted setup and early-exit loop reaches an arbitrary continuation with zero for none or encodedIndex index for the first matching index, together with the corresponding noneFrame or someFrame and folded frame projections.
